blocks.content: Quiz: Assuming the hello.txt file exists, what does the following code do?

f = open('hello.txt', 'r')

content = f.read()
print(content)

f.close()

Prints the first line of the line.
f.read() reads the whole content of the file, not just the first line.

Prints the first 10 characters of the file.
f.read() reads the whole content of the file, not just the first 10 characters.
